description: This Java class models the <entity-data-reader> element in the entity configuration XML, providing methods to access its name and associated resource list.

classes.name: EntityDataReader
classes.description: A thread-safe immutable class representing an entity data reader configuration element, including its name and resource list.

methods.name: EntityDataReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing EntityDataReader with a name, throws exception if name is null or empty.

methods.name: EntityDataReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing EntityDataReader from an XML Element, parsing name and resource elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of the entity data reader.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of resource objects associated with this data reader.
